descriptionText:
TETRAHED INC is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to build and maintain software features and contribute to production systems. The role involves collaborating with engineering and cross-functional teams, participating in code reviews and optimization, and improving systems, tools, and processes.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain software features using Java and/or Python
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that follows engineering best practices
Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver features end-to-end
Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization
Learn and apply leadership principles and operational excellence practices
Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, tools, and processes
Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
0–2 years of professional software development experience (internships, co-ops, or strong academic projects count)
Proficiency in Java and/or Python
Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
Familiarity with version control (Git), basic Linux/Unix commands, and software development lifecycle
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
OPT (F-1) visa status or eligibility preferred; we support OPT candidates
Experience with at least one of: REST APIs, microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, or cloud services (AWS preferred)
Academic or personal projects demonstrating clean coding practices and system design basics
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment
Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision benefits
401(k)
Employee discounts
Opportunity to work on systems that impact millions of customers
Career growth paths within the engineering organization
Hybrid work; expectations will be confirmed during the interview process
Company Overview
TetraHed, Inc. It was founded in undefined, and is headquartered in Austin, Texas, USA, with a workforce of 51-200 employees. Its website is https://www.tetrahed.com.
Company H1B Sponsorship
TETRAHED INC has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships, with 3 in 2024. Please note that this does not guarantee sponsorship for this specific role.
